attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.1 Report hazard button and turn stalk as raw states**

SCCM_Lighting shall send the current state of the hazard warning button (HazardLightButton: 0 released, 1 pressed) and of the turn stalk (TurnStalk.TurnSignal: 0 neutral, 1 left, 2 right) in every 50 ms cycle on DriverCan0.

It shall not latch, toggle or otherwise interpret these inputs.

description: Allocated to building block LightingRequestSensing. LightingRequestSensing only has to see the driver's input. Keeping it a raw-state reporter puts all toggle and precedence logic in one place, LightingControl, so that logic is specified and tested once. A press of at least 100 ms spans a whole 50 ms cycle and so reaches the bus in at least one frame.
